notes.title: Alpha Playtest Recap | We Will Be Gods
notes.content:
[h2][b]Thank You for Playing [i]We Will Be Gods![/i][/b][/h2][p]On [b]May 17[/b], we opened the gates to Hamarvast for the first time. Over two weeks, thousands of players stepped in - and together, we brought the world to life...[/p][p][/p][h2]🔥 Alpha by Numbers[/h2][h3]📥 11,000+ sign-ups[/h3][h3]🧡 9,400+ Steam wishlists[/h3][h3]🌍 2 dedicated servers - one in North America and one in Europe[/h3][h3]⏱️ 2.4 hours playtime on average[/h3][h3]📆 3 Seasons[/h3][h3]🏆 Top participants clocking up to 60 hours of testing[/h3][h2]
🏁 Milestones Achieved So Far[/h2][h3]✅ Alpha Launch (May 17)[/h3][h3]✅ Global Servers Deployed (NA & EU)[/h3][h3]✅ 3 Seasonal Test Phases Completed[/h3][h3]✅ Final Playtest Wrapped Up (May 31)[/h3][h3]✅ Player Feedback Collected + Analyzed[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][p]Huge milestone for us and for [i]We Will Be Gods[/i], and [b]just the beginning [/b]of what’s to come. From bug reports to suggestions, your feedback has already made a great impact on our development process![/p][p]The final playtest wrapped up on [b]May 31[/b], and we’re now diving deeper into everything we learned.[/p][p][/p][h2] ➡️ What happens next?[/h2][p]We will be implementing more content, new features and continuing to develop the world based on everything we learned during the Alpha. A lot of your feedback aligns with ideas already on our roadmap, and your input continues to shape what we build next.[/p][p]While we don’t have a confirmed date for the next playtest just yet, we’ll be sharing regular updates during the downtime - including behind-the-scenes looks, sneak peeks, Q&As with the dev team, and much more![/p][p][/p][h2]🤝 Stay connected:[/h2][list][*][p]Join our [url="http://discord.gg/wewillbegods"]Discord [/url]to follow development, behind-the-scenes and future tests[/p][/*][*][p]Add [i]We Will Be Gods[/i] to your Steam wishlist[/p][/*][*][p]Subscribe to our newsletter on our [url="https://www.wewillbegods.com/"]website[/url] for updates[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]❤️ /Matilda, Senior Community Manager, Cult of the North[/p]

notes.title: Alpha Playtest is Live! | We Will Be Gods
notes.content:
[h2]The gates to Hamarvast are OPEN![/h2]

Sign up [url=https://wewillbegods.firstlook.gg/]here[/url] to be part of this epic Alpha adventure!

[b]I signed up - what happens next?
[/b]Hang tight! You’ll get a second email asking you to link your Steam ID. A third email will follow with your Steam key.

[b]FAQ:[/b]  
🗓️ Servers will be open from [b]May 17 to May 31[/b] [i](with a slight chance of extension)[/i]  
🌍 We’re starting with [b]1 EU server[/b] for opening weekend — more regions will roll out starting [b]May 19[/b]!  
🔁 Servers reset weekly during Alpha  
🎮 Stay updated and chat with us in our [url=https://discord.gg/dSwnMvy9J2]official Discord community[/url]

[b]Can I stream the Alpha?[/b]  
Absolutely! Stream, share, and spread the word — we’d love to see your adventures.

[h2]Everyone will get to play — invites are just paced![/h2]

This is an early Alpha build, so some features may be missing — but what you’ll see is just the beginning 👀✨  
Expect PvE, PvP, gathering, building, and more — with plenty of surprises coming throughout the Alpha.

The team and I will be active all weekend: playing, streaming, and supporting you on your journey through Hamarvast! ⚔️🚀

❤️ /Matilda, Senior Community Manager, Cult of the North
